text:
leah: Quick update — Private/VPC On‑Prem: Customer Readiness Kit is GA as of today. Wave 1 customer enablements start next Mon (see rollout plan). Key pieces: install playbook, compliance checklist (SOC2/FedRAMP notes), onprem-agent 2.2.0 installer, and a short customer runbook for post-install verification.

martin: Thanks! What changed from the beta kit?

leah: Beta -> GA diffs: tightened default telemetry opt-in (now off by default), added KMS/HSM attestation checklist, explicit network port mapping for air-gapped installs, and a hardened migration rollback plan. Also included sample terraform for VPC peering.

carmen: Pinged sales enablement to add the two-slide summary to the customer deck. Link to kit: https://intranet.redwood/platform/onprem/readiness-kit (internal).

raj: For Dedicated/Private SRE: do we have an official SLA handoff template for customers wanting the 99.9% latency SLO?

leah: Yes — kit contains an 'SLA handoff' doc and a one-page checklist for account teams. It lists required capacity reservations, model pinning guidance, and fallback routing policies. Please signpost any gaps.

emily: Ops‑bot: deploying onprem-agent 2.2.0 release notes?

ops-bot: Deploy triggered: onprem-agent v2.2.0 published to internal artifact repo. Changelog: fixed cert rotation bug (CR-472), improved agent memory footprint on t4g nodes, added --rollback-mode flag for fast revert.

martin: Security note: customers using HSM attestation will need to supply their attestation cert chain. I added a short template to the kit under compliance/templates.

carmen: Customer onboarding checklist: can we add a step for “verify network egress rules for telemetry” and mark default telemetry OFF in the pre-install questions? Sales asked for this.

leah: Good call — updated checklist. Also: we've updated the 'customer readiness email template' so SEs can schedule the install window. SEs, please use that template and include the pre-install validation steps.

raj: Will we be doing a canary with one onprem customer this week or start next week?

leah: Canary starts next Wed with ACME Corp (consent signed). Ops/SRE will pair with the customer's infra lead for the first 3 hours. If no regressions, remaining Wave 1 customers will be scheduled over 2 weeks.

emily: Noted — SRE rota updated for Wed morning. Anyone want the on-call handoff doc for the canary?

martin: I'll review the runbook tonight and flag anything security-related.

carmen: Thx — I'll update the enablement slide and ping growth to add to the customer portal.

leah: Action items: 1) Martin — review runbook (today EOD). 2) Carmen — slide + portal update (tomorrow). 3) Raj/Emily — SRE pairing schedule for Wed. 4) SEs — start inviting customers using the new email template. I'll post a short executive note for the all-hands. :tada:

ops-bot: Reminder: please opt-in to telemetry per customer consent. Default is OFF for GA installs.

leah: Thanks team — tagging @here for visibility. Any blockers, reply here and I'll coordinate.
